listen: Good morning. This is The Daily Brief for Monday, October 12, 2026. The lead story: Federal agents searched the Washington home of Representative Ilhan Omar. The Justice Department says it approved the warrant, and says the search is part of an ongoing federal investigation. Omar has called the search an attempt to target political enemies. Now, the front page. Ukraine says six energy sites have been hit by Russia since Trump announced a ceasefire, even though he said energy infrastructure would not be targeted. A Saudi minister has vowed a serious response after Houthi attacks hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people. One person was killed and four were injured in an incident on the Goliath rollercoaster at Six Flags Over Georgia. Details have not been released. A European biopharma company has taken first steps toward a multi-billion-dollar campus in Gwinnett County. In Tech and AI, Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program for security professionals. In Politics, the Justice Department is investigating TV networks for possible antitrust violations. In World news, French supermarkets were hit by an overnight cyber attack that spoiled food. In Sports, 49ers receiver Deebo Samuel is expected to miss at least a couple of weeks with a hamstring injury. In Atlanta, the Atlanta Dream beat the New York Liberty to reach the WNBA Finals. In Architecture, a new study looks at AI as a 3D modeller for BIM work. In Science and Nature, Chinook salmon are returning to the Klamath River after four dams were removed. That is the brief. Have a good day.

lead.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home, DOJ says it approved the warrant
lead.note: Federal agents searched the Washington, D.C. home of Representative Ilhan Omar, according to the item. The Justice Department says it approved the warrant and that the search is part of an ongoing federal investigation. Omar has called the search an attempt to target political enemies. The item does not give further details about the investigation's scope or findings. Representatives are members of the U.S. House, and a search of a member's home is a rare and notable step for a sitting lawmaker. The report is a straight news account of the official statement from the Justice Department and the response from Omar. Readers following domestic politics should watch for further details from the Justice Department as the investigation proceeds.
